Property.name: KeepDents
Property.HelpText: Each truck keeps its dents and cracked windows when you switch to another truck and back, until the game closes (like part damage). Off: switching trucks straightens the old one.

Property.name: DentStrength
Property.HelpText: How deep each hit dents the body. 1 = Cabela's own numbers (a 12-25 mph hit dents about 0.6 inch). 4 = about 2.5 inches. 10 = about 6 inches, the most a dent can go.

Property.name: SaveDamage
Property.HelpText: Each truck's part damage, dents, cracked windows, fuel and odometer are saved to damage_Car1.bin to damage_Car14.bin in this mod's folder, and come back next time you play. Saved when Sonic gets out, on a truck switch, on a repair and when the game closes. Dents also need "Keep dents per truck". Delete a file (or repair the truck) to start that truck fresh.

Property.name: LandingStrength
Property.HelpText: How much a hard landing (over 1 second in the air) hurts each part. 1 = Cabela's own numbers (a 1.2 s jump landing at 34 mph takes 6 points off each part). 10 = 60 points. 50 = 300 points, about the old mod's guess. Landings under 25 mph do no part damage at any setting, as in Cabela's. Dents from landings use Dent strength.

Property.name: UseFuel
Property.HelpText: On: the truck burns fuel like in Cabela's (a full tank lasts 15 to 40 minutes at 3000 RPM, depending on the truck and 2x4 / 4x4 / 4x4 Low). When it runs dry the engine stops; get out and hold D-pad up 2 seconds to repair and fill the tank. Off: no fuel is used, the tank never runs dry and the fuel gauge is hidden.

Property.name: TruckVolume
Property.HelpText: Volume of all the truck's sounds (engine, starter, horn, water, damage), 0 to 100. It is also multiplied by the Mod Manager's sound effect volume (Game Config, Sound, SEVolume), and the truck is silent when the game's sound is turned off there.
